test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2023: Official Paper (Held On: 07 Aug, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Who among the following Indian shuttlers has won the Silver medal in the u - 17 women's singles at Badminton Asia Junior Championship 2022?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Unnati Hooda**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Unnati Hooda:-**

 
 
• She is an Indian badminton player who won the silver medal in the u-17 women's singles at Badminton Asia Junior Championship 2022 held in Jakarta, Indonesia. 
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Amar Verma:- **

 
 
• He is an Indian male badminton player who plays in the men's singles category.
 
 
 
• **Aryan Shah:-**
 
 
• He is an Indian male badminton player who plays in the men's doubles category.
 
 
 
• **Abhishek Kiran:-**
 
 
• He is an Indian male badminton player who plays in the mixed doubles category.
